title: Providing LED street light, flood light, aesthetic street light and garden light at Deep Bhavan premises
summary: E-tender for supplying and installing LED street lights, flood lights, aesthetic street lights and garden lights in the Deep Bhavan premises of the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijaya Puram

sites.name: Deep Bhavan premises, Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijaya Puram
sites.work: LED street lights, flood lights, aesthetic street lights and garden lights

scope.item: Providing LED street light, flood light, aesthetic street light and garden light (no BOQ in these pages)

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST. EMD by FDR of any scheduled nationalized bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijaya Puram, valid 06 months from technical bid opening (Hindi version also allows bank guarantee). NSIC/MSME registered bidders considered for exemption from EMD/tender fee/past experience/turnover as per Govt. norms.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Similar work = supply and installation of street light work (street light and flood light) with Central Govt./State Govt./public listed company/PSU in remote island of Andaman & Nicobar Islands
Initial eligibility criteria as per Section 3 (not included in these pages)
notes: Extract of pages 3-7 of a 54-page tender document (Section I, Hindi and English). EMD amount in words reads 'Rupees Fourteen Thousand Six Hundred Only', contradicting the figure Rs 39,719 (Hindi words match 39,719). Bid download/submission 20.12.2024 17:00 to 09.01.2025 15:00.
